notes.title: Eclipse Chronicles: DLC Transformed into a Short Story!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Due to the unexpected volume of text in the DLC, it is no longer suitable for release in a game format. Therefore, we have decided to present it as a short story, now available on the “Guides” section of the Steam community.

This short story reveals the truth about Osprey’s life in the Eclipse Tower, a story unknown to Arsenka.

Thank you for your continued attention and support! The sequel, Project II: Silent Valley, is in full development—stay tuned!

—Cyrivan Zhao

notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that by the end of January 2025, the game will be updated with a free visual novel DLC and various bug fixes. This DLC tells the story of Osprey’s life in the Eclipse Tower and will be unlockable from the main menu after completing the game.

notes.title: "Project Silent Valley" Chicago Project Game Prequel Production Revealed
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce that the development of Project Silent Valley, the prequel to Chicago Project, is officially underway! Set in the year 2025, this new installment will delve deep into the backstory of two familiar characters from Chicago Project’s lore—Hierophan Hemersfield and Osprey. You’ll get to experience their past and join them in uncovering the secrets that lie behind “Silent Valley.”

Project Silent Valley will feature a semi-open world design, blending card mechanics with puzzle-solving elements to deliver a fresh gameplay experience. With a classic 45° isometric perspective and powered by the Unity engine, the game will provide an engaging balance of immersive visuals and intuitive gameplay.

Stay tuned for more updates, as we will be revealing additional details early next year! Thank you for your continued support, and we look forward to having you join us on this thrilling journey into the prequel.

— Cyrivan Zhao

notes.title: Game Version 1.01 Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear "Chicago Project" Players,

We are excited to announce a major update to "Chicago Project" coming soon! This update focuses on enhancing the game experience and addressing some known issues. Here are the main highlights of the update:

[b]1. New Log Feature: [/b]Players can now review past storylines anytime during the free action phase, making it easier to track story progress.
[b]2. Simplified Chase Sequences:[/b] We've streamlined the chase sequences to improve game fluidity and player experience.
[b]3. Optimized Dark Vision:[/b] In response to player feedback, we've brightened the game's dark scenes for clearer visibility.
[b]4. Text Corrections: [/b]The update corrects some text display and formatting errors in both English and Chinese.
[b]5. Flashlight Prompt Fix:[/b] We've fixed an issue where the game incorrectly indicated that the flashlight was lost in Chapter Two, even if it wasn't picked up.
[b]6. Dialogue Box Optimization:[/b] We've resolved issues with dialogue boxes to ensure that text and character names are correctly synchronized and disappear appropriately.
[b]7. Tunnel Phone Call Bug: [/b]We've fixed a bug where players could repeatedly receive calls from Iliana in the tunnel storyline by entering and exiting the area.

We are committed to continually enhancing your gaming experience. Thank you for your support and understanding. Stay tuned for more updates and improvements.

Look forward to the update and happy gaming!

notes.title: Chicago Project Game Discussion Group Was Built!
notes.content:
Welcome to the Chicago Project Game Discussion Groups!

We are thrilled to have you here to discuss, share, and explore everything about Chicago Project. To make sure every player can communicate comfortably in their preferred language, we have set up two discussion platforms for our community:

English Discussion Group (Discord: https://discord.gg/Sndw4k3y): This Discord server is the primary hub for English-speaking players. Here, you can discuss anything related to the game—share strategies, ask questions, offer feedback, and dive into the stories and characters that shape Chicago Project. Our team will also be active here to answer your questions and listen to your suggestions. Be sure to keep an eye out for game updates, events, and developer announcements as well!

Chinese Discussion Group (QQ Group: 182479540): For our Chinese-speaking players, we have created a dedicated QQ group. If you're more comfortable communicating in Chinese, feel free to join this group for discussions, tips, and updates related to the game. It's also a great place to interact with other Chinese players who share your passion for Chicago Project.

Wherever you decide to join, we hope these discussion spaces will help you connect with fellow players and enhance your experience in Chicago Project. If you have any questions, feedback, or just want to chat about the game, don't hesitate to jump in!

Please be sure to follow the community guidelines and maintain a respectful and friendly atmosphere. We're aiming to create a positive and inclusive space for everyone.

Looking forward to seeing you there and hearing your thoughts on Chicago Project!

notes.title: Game Official Release/Compensation Gift
notes.content:
"Chicago Project" is officially released!

After a lengthy waiting period and a rigorous review process, the game is now live and available for immediate purchase and download.

To celebrate the launch and compensate for the delay, the publisher has announced a limited-time promotional event: starting now and for the next 24 hours, until September 15, 2024, at 10 pm (CST), players who send a screenshot of their purchase confirmation to the official email chicagoproject@163.com will receive a free game DLC. This DLC includes a comprehensive game settings collection and a captivating original soundtrack. Please note that the DLC is also subject to the End User License Agreement (EULA) included in the email.

Thank you to all players for your support and cooperation, and enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: Postponement Of Offering Due To Delay In Review
notes.content:
Dear players,

The game developers are very sorry to announce that the release will be delayed due to audit issues. The game was submitted for review on August 29th, but the review has not yet been completed. Once approved, the game will be immediately available for release. As compensation, we will provide not only a collection of game settings but also a free original soundtrack to players who purchase the game at launch. Please look forward to it.

Best regards,

Cyrivan Zhao
